title: An Unconventional Assault
description: Aboard his command ship, Allegiant General Pryde figures out the Resistance plan and moves the navigation signal up to the very ship he's on. Finn senses the signal has been transferred to the destroyer and moves the ground assault up to the ship, landing troop transports on the surface of Pryde's Sith Star Destroyer. He then unleashes not only the Resistance forces, but Jannah's company 77, complete with stampeding orbaks.
